signature.name: Grossmünster
signature.detail: Zurich's iconic twin-towered Romanesque church, the legendary birthplace of the Reformation in German-speaking Switzerland. Climb the tower for sweeping views over the old town and lake. Go early morning to avoid crowds; modest dress recommended.

signature.name: Fraumünster Church
signature.detail: Famous for its stunning stained-glass windows by Marc Chagall and Augusto Giacometti, set in a serene Romanesque church. A must for art and architecture lovers. Visit on a weekday morning for quieter viewing; small entry fee for the church.

signature.name: Lindenhof
signature.detail: A tranquil hilltop square with Roman ruins and a lime tree, offering the best free panorama of the Limmat River and old town. Perfect for a picnic or sunset stroll. Reach it via short stairs from the river; go at dusk for romantic views.

food: Casual meal $20-30; mid-range dinner $50-80 per person
transport: Tram/bus single ride $4.50; day pass $9; taxis expensive
